license_required.quote: After December 31, 2005, a person may not practice, nor represent that the person is able to practice, polysomnography unless licensed under this chapter as a registered polysomnographic technologist.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the state board of respiratory care.

name.quote: "Board" means the state board of respiratory care.

type.quote: "Board" means the state board of respiratory care.

degree_required.value: Education requirements as established by board rules under section 43-42-04.1
degree_required.quote: the board shall require evidence that the applicant has complied with the rules adopted by the board under section 43-42-04.1

school_approval_basis.quote: The rules may include requirements for examination requirements for licensure, education requirements for licensure, continuing courses of study in polysomnography, and student practice.

experience_source.quote: the board shall require evidence that the applicant has complied with the rules adopted by the board under section 43-42-04.1

exams.name: Examination as required by board rules
exams.notes: The statute authorizes the board to establish examination requirements by rule; the specific exam is not named in the statute.
exams.quote: The rules may include requirements for examination requirements for licensure

interval_years.quote: Licenses issued under this chapter expire annually, but may be renewed upon application to the board and payment of the annual renewal fee established by the board.

required.quote: The board shall require as a condition of renewal and relicensure that the applicant demonstrate satisfactory completion of continuing courses of study in respiratory care.

available.quote: An applicant for licensure under this chapter may be granted a license upon satisfactory proof to the board that the applicant is licensed to practice respiratory care under the laws of another state which impose substantially the same requirements as this chapter

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state under substantially the same requirements as North Dakota, and pay the annual license fee.
requirements.quote: An applicant for licensure under this chapter may be granted a license upon satisfactory proof to the board that the applicant is licensed to practice respiratory care under the laws of another state which impose substantially the same requirements as this chapter, and upon payment of the annual license fee.

exists.quote: "Board" means the state board of respiratory care.

regulatory_model.quote: After December 31, 2005, a person may not practice, nor represent that the person is able to practice, polysomnography unless licensed under this chapter as a registered polysomnographic technologist.

credential_type.quote: The board shall license as a registered polysomnographic technologist any applicant whom the board determines to be qualified to perform the duties of a registered polysomnographic technologist.

is_mandatory.quote: After December 31, 2005, a person may not practice, nor represent that the person is able to practice, polysomnography unless licensed under this chapter as a registered polysomnographic technologist.

title_protection.quote: a person may not practice, nor represent that the person is able to practice, polysomnography unless licensed under this chapter as a registered polysomnographic technologist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Applicant or licensee is not qualified or competent to perform the duties of a registered polysomnographic technologist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is not qualified or competent to perform the duties of a registered respiratory therapist, a certified respiratory therapist, or a registered polysomnographic technologist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempted to obtain or obtained licensure by fraud or material misrepresentation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has attempted to obtain or has obtained licensure under this chapter by fraud or material misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found by the board to have been grossly negligent as a registered polysomnographic technologist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been found by the board to have been grossly negligent as a registered respiratory therapist, certified respiratory therapist, or registered polysomnographic technologist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in conduct as a registered polysomnographic technologist which is unethical, unprofessional, or detrimental to the health of the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in conduct as a registered respiratory therapist, certified respiratory therapist, or registered polysomnographic technologist which is unethical, unprofessional, or detrimental to the health of the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failed to demonstrate satisfactory completion of required continuing courses of study.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has failed to demonstrate satisfactory completion of such continuing courses of study in respiratory care as the board may require.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted or adjudged guilty of an offense with a direct bearing on ability to practice polysomnography and not sufficiently rehabilitated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted or adjudged guilty of an offense, as defined by section 12.1-01-04, determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon that individual's ability to practice respiratory care or polysomnography and is not sufficiently rehabilitated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Is habitually drunk or addicted to a controlled substance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is habitually drunk or is addicted to the use of a controlled substance as defined in chapter 19-03.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Declared mentally incompetent by a court and not thereafter lawfully declared competent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been declared mentally incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction, and who has not thereafter been lawfully declared competent.

definition_quote.value: "Polysomnography" means the practice of attending, monitoring, and recording physiologic data during sleep for the purpose of identifying and assisting in the treatment of sleep-wake disorders.
definition_quote.quote: "Polysomnography" means the practice of attending, monitoring, and recording physiologic data during sleep for the purpose of identifying and assisting in the treatment of sleep-wake disorders.

value: supervision as prescribed by the board by rule
supervision_level_definitions.quote: "Registered polysomnographic technologist" means an individual licensed by the board to practice polysomnography under supervision as prescribed by the board by rule.

listing_vs_licensure_model.quote: The board shall license as a registered polysomnographic technologist any applicant whom the board determines to be qualified to perform the duties of a registered polysomnographic technologist.

respiratory_care_board_jurisdiction.quote: "Board" means the state board of respiratory care.

respiratory_care_practitioner_exemption.quote: This section does not prohibit a respiratory therapist from practicing respiratory care.
